column1: # `/bin/calloopgate` is a calloop event loop on the port: a calloop timer (the poll-timeout
# path), a timerfd (a deadline in the port's timer server), an eventfd and a pipe, all four
# registered with one loop and all four dispatched. It is a separate cargo project
# (`tools/phase4-gate`) because it needs the forked OS crates, and it is injected with
# MINIXFS_EXTRA rather than carried by every image, like bash: an image should not depend on
# calloop unless its own gate built it.

column2: calloopgate: PASS timer, timerfd, eventfd and pipe all dispatched
